name: Milan Metro Status
description: Milan Metro Status delivers real-time operational status for all five Milan metro lines (M1, M2, M3, M4, and M5) directly inside Claude. It lets you instantly check whether lines are running normally, experiencing delays, or suspended. Ask about the entire network at once or filter by a specific line. No sign-up required, always up to date, and designed to fit naturally into any travel or commute conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Milan Metro Status to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Milan Metro Status to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://aged-dream-021h7.run.mcp-use.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Milan Metro Status MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Milan Metro Status provides these MCP tools: get-metro-status.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Milan Metro Status?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Milan Metro Status in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, and Skimetric.

_published_faq.name: Does Milan Metro Status MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Milan Metro Status does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Milan Metro Status is developed by Salvatore Cordiano. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
